newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: BIB H1 97 net profit up 12 pct.
newsitem.headline: BIB H1 97 net profit up 12 pct.

text.p: Bahrain International Bank (BIB) said on Sunday it made a $10.1 million net profit in the first six months of 1997, up 12 percent from the same period a year earlier.
The Bahrain-based bank made a $8.98 million net profit in the first half of 1996.
"All our key business areas performed extremely well during the first half of 1997. We expect a stronger performance in the second half of this year," Chief Executive Robin McIlvenny said.
BIB, an offshsore banking unit, said in a statement that fee income from Gulf-related investment banking business continued to accrue at record levels, but gave no figures.
